PullRequest.Title: chat: preserve dynamic provider labels in session hovers
PullRequest.Body:

## Summary

Session hovers treated dynamically registered providers as Local even though the session already carried its provider label and icon. Use that supplied identity in both the rich header and the fallback shown when history cannot load. Retain canonical harness icons for built-in providers.

Tests cover Cloud, an ordinary remote provider, local sessions, and a built-in provider with a custom item icon.

## How to test

Hover a saved cloud conversation and confirm it says Cloud, not Local. Confirm the same identity remains when its history cannot load, and ordinary local/remote hover labels remain correct.

## Validation

- `npm run build-fast -- --client-only` — passed.
- `./scripts/test.sh --reporter dot --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/agentSessions/agentSessionHoverWidget.test.ts --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/agentSessions/agentSessionsRenderer.test.ts --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/agentSessions/agentSessionsAccessibilityProvider.test.ts` — 19 passing.
- `npm run eslint -- src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/agentSessions/agentSessionHoverWidget.ts src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/agentSessions/agentSessionHoverWidget.test.ts` — passed.
- `npm run typecheck-client` and `npm run valid-layers-check` — passed on the combined validation branch.

Not run: manual screen-reader or live cloud-session verification.

Scenarios.Scenario: Hover an unread or in-progress dynamically registered agent session and render its rich header/history preview
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Delayed hover creation synchronously builds the header; the changed lines select an existing ThemeIcon and providerLabel in constant time. On show, acquireOrLoadSession begins, while rich list rendering remains delayed by 200 ms and waits for the model. The existing observeSession provider resolve is asynchronous and is not required for the initial header to display.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Resolve lazy session details through the registered chat-session provider; remote providers may cross the extension/agent-host boundary and perform provider-specific network work.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most one resolve per session resource while _resolvedResources contains that resource; the observable is also cached by resource.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same buildHeader call invoked observeSession and triggered the same deduplicated provider resolve before this PR.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Runs asynchronously from hover construction and may update diff details later; it does not block initial provider identity rendering.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Read serialized local chat session data when no live local model exists.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One read for the hovered local session on a cold model; a live model is reused on warm access.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The hover called the same acquireOrLoadSession path before the PR.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Rich history preview waits for this read, but the header is already built.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Ask the registered remote session provider for session history via getOrCreateChatSession, potentially including provider-owned network access, then replay the history into a model.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One provider load per cold hovered resource, coalesced across concurrent consumers; warm live models are reused.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same model load and history replay occurred on hover before the PR with identical scheduling and cardinality.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The rich history preview waits for content retrieval and replay; initial header identity does not.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One hover widget per currently hovered session; header work is O(1). Existing history replay scales with that session's history length, but the changed label/icon selection does not affect it.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The viewer retains one current AgentSessionHoverWidget and replaces/disposes it when moving to another session. Remote model loads are coalesced by session resource in _remoteSessionLoads; concurrent consumers share one load, and loss of the final consumer cancels/abandons it. The diff does not change concurrency.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Warm live models bypass storage/provider loading. Cold remote loads are keyed and coalesced by session resource; session-detail resolves are guarded and observables cached by resource. The diff changes no key, hit/miss state, negative-cache behavior, or coalescing.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: changed lines and renderIcon implementation show only in-memory string/class selection, while the unchanged call path proves identical boundary count and scheduling.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Provider latency and session history length vary, but those costs and their trigger are unchanged. ThemeIcon class generation and providerLabel insertion are bounded constant-time operations.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. Dynamic identity rendering neither adds expensive work nor increases boundary frequency, retained state, layout work, or history replay cardinality.

Scenarios.Scenario: Show the fallback tooltip when a hovered session's history cannot be loaded
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The existing acquireOrLoadSession attempt must finish without a model, then buildFallbackTooltip constructs a short MarkdownString. The changed lines substitute session.icon.id and session.providerLabel for the previous built-in fallback values; no additional await or boundary is added.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Attempt local session-store restoration for a local session.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most one attempt per widget because modelRef is memoized; warm models avoid the read.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The fallback already waited on this same load attempt before constructing its text.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Fallback waits until the load attempt returns undefined.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Attempt remote provider session retrieval before determining no model is available.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One cold load per resource, coalesced for concurrent consumers and reused when a live model exists.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The pre-diff fallback followed the identical remote load attempt.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Fallback waits for the remote attempt to complete.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Fallback text size scales only with existing session tooltip/description/badge content; the changed provider label and icon ID contribute one bounded field each and do not alter multiplicity.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: One fallback construction follows the single coalesced load for the active hovered resource. Repeated onRendered calls reuse modelRef, and replacing the hovered session disposes/cancels the prior widget.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: modelRef memoizes the widget's result, existing live models are reused, and in-flight remote requests are coalesced by resource. The diff leaves all cache behavior unchanged.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the diff is after the unchanged load boundary and only changes which already-stored icon ID and label enter one MarkdownString.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Provider failure latency can vary, but it is pre-existing and unaffected; changed fallback formatting is negligible and bounded.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The fallback has the same boundary calls, wait time, allocation shape, and invocation count as before.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance review of all changed files and hunks. The production change replaces built-in fallback identity values with existing session metadata in two hover render paths. It does not introduce or amplify synchronous UI work, boundary fan-out, cache misses, retained state, or concurrency, and the added tests do not affect product runtime.
